steps: Confirm your Nurse license is active and in good standing in Ohio.
Verify Florida is a compact member state and set it as your primary state of residence.
Update your address with your home-state nursing board so your multistate privilege applies to the new state.
Await processing — typically 5-15 days in Florida.
notes: Florida's nurse licensing requirements are administered per the state's licensing authority. Florida trade licenses are issued by the Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR); healthcare licenses go through the Department of Health. Always confirm current rules directly with the official board before applying, since requirements change.
